jobs.occupation: Lead Chef for Veranda, our chef table
jobs.description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365, a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Chef to lead our show-cooking experience at Veranda Restaurant at ICEHOTEL for the winter season 2026/2027. The Veranda experience is more than a dinner. It is a fine dining experience where we cook and present the food in front of our guests. Bring your experience, personality, skills and passion to help us share the story behind our new menu, inspired by the eight Sámi seasons.

Responsibilities

Lead the kitchen team at Veranda Restaurant.

Cook and present food in front of our guests.

Share the story behind the menu through storytelling as you cook.

Contribute ideas to the Veranda experience.

Who are you?

You bring a positive personality, ideas and a genuine passion for hospitality. You enjoy interacting with guests and are comfortable sharing the stories behind the food as you cook and present it.

Qualifications

Strong professional kitchen experience.

Previous experience in fine dining and leading a kitchen team is essential.

Comfortable working in a chef’s table and open-kitchen setting.

Experience with Nordic flavours and food culture.

Fluent English is required. Swedish is an advantage.

About the position

Type of employment: Seasonal employment for winter 2026/2027.

Start date: As agreed.

Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

A supportive and inclusive team culture.

Staff benefits and discounts.

Applications are only accepted through this application platform. The position may be filled before the closing date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, please contact diego@icehotel.com.

To be eligible for the position, you must be an EU citizen or have a valid work permit in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Electronics Engineer in Antenna Technology for a Leading Technology Company
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about wireless communication, advanced RF technology, and antenna design? Would you like to work with cutting-edge technology in one of the region’s most advanced development environments? We are now looking for an Electronics Engineer with experience in antenna design for an exciting consulting assignment with our client in Lund!
About the role
As an Electronics Engineer – Antenna, you will play a key role in technically advanced development projects where the wireless products of the future are being developed. You will work on everything from concept development and simulation to practical measurements, verification, and optimization of antennas for products within consumer electronics, IoT, industrial applications, or automotive.
You will join an environment characterized by cutting-edge expertise and access to world-class laboratory facilities. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and cross-functional teams, where your expertise in antenna design will have a direct impact.
You are offered:
A stimulating workplace with exciting projects, modern laboratory environments, and excellent opportunities for professional development.
The position starts as a consulting assignment with very good opportunities for direct employment with the client.

Work tasks
Your focus will cover the entire process, from simulation and design to practical measurements and verification of antennas.
Design, simulate, and integrate antennas into compact electronics and wireless hardware systems.  
Perform RF and antenna measurements, such as TRP, TIS, S-parameters, and radiation patterns, in advanced laboratory environments and anechoic chambers.  
Identify and resolve performance issues and fine-tune antenna systems to maximize range and reliability.  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate antennas into end products.  
Document technical specifications and test results.

We are looking for
A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Electronics Design, Telecommunications, or an equivalent field.
Demonstrated experience in antenna design. You may be an experienced engineer or a more junior candidate who has completed challenging and relevant antenna design projects, for example through a thesis, research project, or hands-on development project.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.

It is a plus if you have
Experience with antenna integration for IoT, consumer electronics, automotive, or MedTech.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Company Description
 
Are you an analytical and goal-oriented person with a passion for forest
management and sustainable development who likes to work in a team? Do you
want to work in a global organization that makes a difference for both people and the planet? Then the role of Forestry Analyst could be right for you!
 
Why Inter IKEA?
With us, you become part of a global community that values innovation, collaboration and responsibility. We offer:
• The opportunity to influence the development of sustainable forest resources.
• A dynamic and inclusive work environment where your voice is heard.
• A company that actively works for a better climate and to create value for both
people and the planet.
Job Description
As Forestry Analyst at Inter IKEA Forest Investments, you will play a key role in the development of our portfolio of forest assets. You will work with:
• Data Collection and Preparation, collect relevant data for the forest area,
including topography, soil type, climate data, and current forest inventory.
• GIS and Remote Sensing Analysis, Use GIS, and remote sensing
technologies to analyze the spatial characteristics of the forest area.
• Scenario Analysis Use models to run various management scenarios, such as
different harvesting regimes, reforestation plans, return requirements and
climate change impacts.
• Risk Assessment: Conduct a risk assessment based on the model’s
projections, identifying potential risks to forest health and productivity...
• Stakeholder Communication, prepare communication materials to present the
model’s findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including forest
managers, conservation organizations, and policymakers.
• Integration with Management Plans, Integrate the model’s results into existing
forest management plans, suggesting modifications based on the model’s
projections.
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, innovation and a
passion for forest management in an organization working to create a better future for future generations.
Qualifications
• Has a university degree in forestry, natural resource management, economics
or a similar field.
• Has experience of using models for analysis and optimization in forestry or
related areas.
• Is used to working with large data sets and analyses.
• Has good communication and collaboration skills, with experience of working
in cross-functional teams.
• Has experience of project management.
• Is self-motivated, solution-oriented and driven by creating sustainable results.
Additional Information
We look forward to receiving your application in English. We regret that we are unable to handle applications made by e-mail. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 17 October 2026. Please note for this position we have a preferred candidate.
